arabicExcerpts.text: ثُمَّ صُبُّواْ فَوۡقَ رَأۡسِهِۦ مِنۡ عَذَابِ ٱلۡحَمِيمِ
إِنَّ هَٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمۡتَرُونَ
لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلۡمَوۡتَ إِلَّا ٱلۡمَوۡتَةَ ٱلۡأُولَىٰۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
فَضۡلٗا مِّن رَّبِّكَۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ

mainSubject.label: The tree of Zaqqum identified as the sinner's food, boiling like murky oil within bellies; seizure and dragging into the Hellfire's midst followed by pouring scalding-water torment over the head with sarcastic address to the formerly honoured and noble, told this is what they disputed; the righteous placed in security within gardens and springs, dressed in fine silk and brocade facing one another, married to fair large-eyed women, calling for every fruit in safety, tasting no death beyond the first and protected from Hellfire as bounty and great attainment; the Quran eased on the Prophet's tongue for remembrance; mutual watching closed with the command to watch while they watch for his end
